# sonrai_suggested_exemptions (Data Source)

Identities the platform would exempt when protecting a service, because they recently used one of its sensitive permissions.

`sonrai_account_protected_service` does not apply these automatically. Review them, then list the ones you want in `exempt_identities` and `exempt_sso_actor_ids`.

The lookback window is an organization setting, so this set changes over time on its own. Referencing `identities` directly keeps exemptions tracking the window; copying the values into configuration keeps them stable until you change them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Identities the platform would exempt when protecting a service. Review these,
# then list the ones you want on the protect resource.
data "sonrai_suggested_exemptions" "iam_prod" {
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "123456789012"
  control_key = "iam"
}

output "review" {
  value = data.sonrai_suggested_exemptions.iam_prod.suggestions
}

# Stable: the reviewed list is written into configuration, so it changes only
# when you change it.
resource "sonrai_account_protected_service" "iam_prod" {
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "123456789012"
  control_key = "iam"

  exempt_identities = [
    "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/CrossAccountIAMAdminRole",
  ]
}

# Tracking: exemptions follow the platform's rolling window. The set changes as
# identities age out of it, so plans show changes nobody made.
resource "sonrai_account_protected_service" "lambda_prod" {
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "123456789012"
  control_key = "lambda"

  exempt_identities    = data.sonrai_suggested_exemptions.lambda_prod.identities
  exempt_sso_actor_ids = data.sonrai_suggested_exemptions.lambda_prod.sso_actor_ids
}

data "sonrai_suggested_exemptions" "lambda_prod" {
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "123456789012"
  control_key = "lambda"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_key` (String) Firewall control key for the service, for example `iam`.
- `resource_id` (String) Cloud-native id of the account.
- `root_scope` (String) Cloud organization root scope, for example `aws/r-abcd`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the form `control_key@scope`.
- `identities` (Set of String) Suggested non-SSO identities, ready to pass to `exempt_identities`.
- `scope` (String) Canonical scope path the account resolved to.
- `sso_actor_ids` (Set of String) Suggested SSO actor ids, ready to pass to `exempt_sso_actor_ids`.
- `suggestions` (Attributes List) Each suggestion with the usage that produced it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--suggestions))

<a id="nestedatt--suggestions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `suggestions`

Read-Only:

- `is_sso` (Boolean)
- `last_sensitive_used` (String)
- `last_sensitive_used_date` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `resource_id` (String)
- `sso_actor_id` (String)
